speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough for about two months, and the shortness of breath has been bothering me whenever I try to do something physically demanding. It seems to get worse with exertion, but I don't have any trouble breathing while sleeping at night. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand the need for a clear classification, but I must first confirm if you have any fever, night sweats, or a history of smoking to narrow down the cause. REQUEST TEST: Chest_XRay.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation with flattened diaphragms, increased retrosternal airspace and a prominent hilar shadow suggestive of emphysema.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with Emphysema.
